scope: ME, EV, ordinary OU, and event-output OU submode

probes.question: non-FREE legacy format warning and preservation
numeric wet-scimming pair versus filename disambiguation
second turbulence keyword rejection after first shared IMSTAT selection
multiple EVENTLOC per event and count-based FINISHED check
same filename/unit across families and normalization behavior
event output EXP behavior under DFAULT
probes.result: EVENT-processing FILEFORM EXP remains exponential for non-DFAULT runs and for DFAULT with a non-criteria pollutant. FILEFORM FIX completes under DFAULT for SO2. FILEFORM EXP under DFAULT for SO2 completes with W595, is internally reset to FIX, and emits fixed-notation event values. The official source applies this reset to DFAULT + PollCrit + EXP and keeps EXP otherwise.
probes.boundary: SO2 is the executable criteria-pollutant case; general criteria-pollutant behavior is supported by the retained PollCrit source branch.

probes.question: THRESH and secondary-rank signatures including trailing unit
probes.result: The primary-rank plus secondary-rank form and the THRESH form both completed with and without an explicit trailing file unit. All four cases generated the requested MAXDCONT output file. THRESH cases emitted W273 and W415 in the selected annual NO2 context without rejecting the record form.
probes.boundary: Short output filenames were used after exploratory E500 file-open failures. This confirms the record signatures and optional unit, not a general filename-length limit.
